name: Anchovy Sauce
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: about half a pint of melted butter
ingredients.originalText: about half a pint of melted butter

instructions.text: Soak eight anchovies for three or four hours, changing the water every hour
Put them into a sauce-pan with a quart of cold water
Set them on hot coals and simmer them till they are entirely dissolved and till the liquid is diminished two-thirds
Stir in two glasses of red wine and add about half a pint of melted butter
Heat it over again and send it to table

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Soak eight anchovies for three or four hours, changing the water every hour
2. Put them into a sauce-pan with a quart of cold water
3. Set them on hot coals and simmer them till they are entirely dissolved and till the liquid is diminished two-thirds
4. Strain it
5. Stir in two glasses of red wine and add about half a pint of melted butter
6. Heat it over again and send it to table
